# Length choice

**How long is the piece?** · [all approaches](index.md)


## 6–15 s proof or vibe reel
<a id="proof-vibe-short"></a>

Very short: one proof, one moment or one vibe, built to loop.

**Looks like:** One shot of the myth disproved, or a sunset with one line, ending on a frame that loops to the start. Viewers watch it three times.

**Good at:** completion and rewatches; reach; fast to make

**Weak at:** little room for teaching or CTA; low save value

**Best for:** formats reel30, yt-short, story · niches all · goals reach, speed · effort low

**How:** End on a frame that matches frame 1 in Edits/CapCut.

**Backed by:** [Length: 7–15 s vibe, 20–60 s value](../topics/editing.md#edit-length-by-type), [End on a frame that loops](../topics/editing.md#edit-loop-to-frame-1), [Teaching format: template card, then a real example](../topics/editing.md#l11-template-then-example), [Travel formats: vibe, dump, POV, "nobody tells you"](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-travel-formats) · sources SP, KH, research

## 30–60 s value reel
<a id="value-30-60"></a>

A tutorial, tip or vlog with one clear payoff.

**Looks like:** Hook, three steps, a save moment and a CTA, all within a minute.

**Good at:** saves; balanced reach and depth; fits most tutorials

**Weak at:** tight for stories; can feel rushed for builds

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals saves, retention · effort medium

**How:** Script to about 120–150 words.

**Backed by:** [Length: 7–15 s vibe, 20–60 s value](../topics/editing.md#edit-length-by-type), [Rahul: ~1 reel a day, two time slots](../topics/growth.md#growth-rahul-cadence), [Expertise hook: years of niche in 60 seconds](../topics/hooks.md#l11-expertise-hook), [Hook window: 2–3 s short, 15–20 s long](../topics/hooks.md#hook-window-short-vs-long) · sources SP, L02

## 60–120 s story or build
<a id="personality-60-120"></a>

Room for story, personality or a full build; Rahul's typical reel is 55–75 s, and story-driven reels of 40 s–2 min work.

**Looks like:** A full PC build with every part and price, or a story with a messy middle and a lesson, over about 75 s.

**Good at:** trust; comments; depth

**Weak at:** the middle must hold; less completion

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90 · niches all · goals trust, comments, follows · effort medium

**How:** Re-open a loop at about 15 s and add a pattern break every 15–20 s.

**Backed by:** [Open loops, re-open one at ~15 s](../topics/story.md#story-open-loops), [Length: 7–15 s vibe, 20–60 s value](../topics/editing.md#edit-length-by-type), [Rahul: ~1 reel a day, two time slots](../topics/growth.md#growth-rahul-cadence), [Mix measured at −14 LUFS](../topics/sound.md#sound-loudness-minus-14), [Study one same-niche creator deeply](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-study-one-creator-deeply) · sources R1, research, L08

## 2–3 min long reel
<a id="long-reel-2-3min"></a>

The longest reels (Rahul's sponsored 161–179 s), still under 3 min for recommendation eligibility.

**Looks like:** A sponsored comparison (dumb, normal, pro) with a full production, pinned to the profile.

**Good at:** room for a sponsor; depth; pinned showcase pieces

**Weak at:** completion drops; Rahul's 161 s sponsored reel reached only 0.17× followers

**Best for:** formats reel90 · niches tech · goals sales · effort high

**How:** Chapter it with section cards; keep it under 3 min.

**Backed by:** [Sponsor as the "pro" answer](../topics/business.md#biz-sponsor-as-smart-option), [Length: 7–15 s vibe, 20–60 s value](../topics/editing.md#edit-length-by-type), [Rahul: ~1 reel a day, two time slots](../topics/growth.md#growth-rahul-cadence), [Don't benchmark a paid outlier](../topics/growth.md#growth-outlier-paid-not-benchmark), [Mix measured at −14 LUFS](../topics/sound.md#sound-loudness-minus-14) · sources R1, SP

## Long form (YouTube)
<a id="long-form"></a>

8+ minute videos with a 15–20 s hook window and value spread through.

**Looks like:** A cold open, a promise, chapters with open loops, and value spread out rather than front-loaded.

**Good at:** conversion; trust; waterfall source

**Weak at:** big time cost; needs titles and thumbnails

**Best for:** formats yt-long, podcast · niches all · goals trust, sales · effort high

**How:** Storyboard by chapters; record in sets; cut in CapCut desktop or VN.

**Backed by:** [Long form: spread the value, don't front-load](../topics/story.md#story-yt-long-spread-value), [Hook window: 2–3 s short, 15–20 s long](../topics/hooks.md#hook-window-short-vs-long), [Short form = awareness, long = conversion](../topics/growth.md#growth-short-awareness-long-conversion), [Accordion: volume to learn, then effort](../topics/growth.md#growth-accordion-method) · sources L05, L07

## Mixing
A long piece can waterfall into short reels of every other length.

## Rule of thumb
Reach and loops: 6–15 s. Saves: 30–60 s. Trust and builds: 60–120 s. Sponsors: 2–3 min. Conversion: long form.
